### Send

``
POST /talk/send
{
  "to":      "<TARGET principal>",
  "scope":   "<governed scope key>",
  "message": "<content>",
  "context": "<optional INTEL context>"
}

Response:
{
  "ok":   true,
  "id":   "<content hash>",
  "ts":   "<ISO 8601>"
}
`

### Inbox

`
GET /talk/inbox?scope=X&limit=50&offset=0

Response:
{
  "scope":   "<scope>",
  "total":   <int>,
  "entries": [{ id, ts, from, to, message, context, read }]
}
`

### Acknowledge

`
POST /talk/ack
{
  "ids": ["<message_id>", ...]
}

Response:
{
  "ok":    true,
  "acked": <count>
}
``
